title: Team members table with invite and remove
describe: a team members table with an invite dialog
prompt:
Build a team page at /team.

Requirements:
- A heading "Team" and a table with the columns Name, Email and Role.
- Three members, hard-coded: Ada Reyes, ada@example.test, Admin; Bo Tran, bo@example.test, Member; Cy Okafor, cy@example.test, Member.
- A button "Invite member" that opens a dialog with a field labelled "Email", a field labelled "Role" (Admin or Member) and a button "Send invite". Sending closes the dialog, adds a row with that email and the role, and shows the message "Invite sent".
- Each row has a button "Remove <name>", for example "Remove Bo Tran". It asks for confirmation in a dialog with a button "Confirm remove". Confirming removes the row.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
